questions.question: Why does English-language film and TV have global influence?
options: Hollywood and American/British content dominate global distribution and shape perceptions
Other countries do not make films
English films are legally required worldwide
questions.explanation: Hollywood produces most globally distributed films, and American and British series stream worldwide, shaping perceptions of these cultures.

questions.question: What is cinematography?
questions.explanation: Cinematography is the art of camera work and visual composition in film.

questions.question: What does "representation" mean in media analysis?
options: How groups of people are portrayed in media
questions.explanation: Representation concerns how groups (genders, ethnicities, cultures) are portrayed — and who gets portrayed at all.

questions.question: What is mise-en-scene?
options: Everything visible within a film frame
questions.explanation: Mise-en-scene is everything visible in the frame: sets, costumes, lighting and actors.

questions.question: Why analyse film and television in English class?
options: Screen media shape views of English-speaking cultures and can be analysed like texts
It replaces the need to learn vocabulary
Only books are part of culture
questions.explanation: Film and TV are powerful cultural texts whose techniques and representations can be analysed critically.
